title: 2013 Dakar Rally
who: Won by Stéphane Peterhansel / Jean-Paul Cottret (Mini) and Cyril Despres (KTM)
summary: The 2013 edition of the Dakar Rally, in its South America era: 13 stage towns and bivouacs through Peru, Chile, Argentina. Winners — Cars: Stéphane Peterhansel / Jean-Paul Cottret (Mini); Bikes: Cyril Despres (KTM); Trucks: Eduard Nikolaev (Kamaz); Quads: Marcos Patronelli (Yamaha).
approximate: Stage towns and bivouacs from Wikipedia's stage table. The rally ran off-road between them, so the lines are straight from bivouac to bivouac.
